jobs.content:
This is a fully remote position. Work from anywhere in the United States — remote in all 50 states; no travel or office attendance required.

We are looking for a motivated team member to join our team. You will support customers by phone, email, and chat, and help resolve questions about products and services. This is a full-time position with benefits including health insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) retirement plan. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. You will work with a friendly team and have clear goals and regular feedback. Strong written communication skills and attention to detail are important. Experience with customer support tools is helpful but not required. We provide training and the equipment you need to do the job well.
